title: Director, Engineering
description:
**About Tekion:**
-----------------

Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking an Engineering Director to lead the Chennai engineering organization for 2 scrum teams, shared platform resources (Architect, ML Engineer, SDET), and a team of ~20 engineers across backend, frontend, AI, and QA disciplines. You will own delivery accountability, team health, technical quality, and the cross-team coordination that keeps two scrum teams moving in the same direction. You will be the primary technical counterpart to the US-based Product leadership, the direct interface to platform teams, and the person who sets the engineering culture for the entire team.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the full Chennai engineering organization (~20 engineers): two Scrum teams, two Engineering Managers, Staff/Senior engineers, Applied ML, and Staff SDET.

* Own delivery accountability: sprint cadence, cross-team dependency management, risk tracking, and executive reporting on engineering progress.

* Set and enforce technical standards: hexagonal architecture discipline, AI-native integration patterns, code quality gates, and observability standards across both teams.

* Act as the primary technical counterpart to US-based Product leadership — translate business requirements into engineering execution plans, surface trade-offs early, and maintain shared understanding of what is being built and why.

* Own the cross-team coordination interface to platform teams (Agentic Engine, Core Platform, ARC backend, Design) — ensuring product dependencies are tracked, escalated, and resolved on schedule.

* Hire, develop, and retain top engineering talent: own the full hiring pipeline, define career ladders, conduct performance reviews, and make compensation decisions.

* Drive the technical roadmap for Phase 2 in partnership with the ML Architect, Applied Scientist, and Product leadership — shaping the next wave of AI capabilities.

* Maintain technical depth: actively participate in architecture reviews, challenge design decisions, and unblock engineers on complex distributed systems and AI integration challenges.

* Build and sustain a high-trust, high-accountability engineering culture where engineers feel ownership, psychological safety, and pride in their craft.

**Skills & Qualifications**

* 12+ years of software engineering experience with 5+ years of engineering leadership — managing managers and leading teams of 15+ engineers.

* Deep technical background in Java backend systems, distributed microservices, and event-driven architecture — able to engage credibly in architecture reviews and design decisions.

* Proven track record building and operating SaaS platforms on AWS with multi-database stacks (MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Kafka, Elasticsearch, Redis/Aerospike).

* Demonstrated experience with hexagonal architecture at scale — enforcing domain isolation as teams and services grow.

* Strong cross-functional leadership: experience working closely with Product Management, Design, and executive stakeholders across geographies (US-India distributed teams).

* Track record of recruiting and developing senior engineering talent — building teams from the ground up in competitive markets.

* Experience delivering in fast-paced, high-ambiguity environments with evolving platform dependencies and shifting priorities.

Good to Have

* Experience leading engineering teams building AI-native products (LLM integration, agentic systems, scoring pipelines, MCP tool design).

* Background in martech, customer data platforms, or dealer/automotive technology.

* Prior experience managing both backend and frontend engineering disciplines within the same org.

Exposure Temporal for durable workflow orchestration at the team level.

**Perks & Benefits**

* Competitive compensation and generous stock options.

* Medical insurance coverage.

* Work with some of the brightest minds from Silicon Valley's most dominant and successful companies.

description:

As a Technical Anchor, you will oversee the technical design, development, and delivery of business-critical applications and high-throughput data platforms. You will establish engineering excellence across full-stack systems, architect resilient Java-based microservices, deliver responsive front-end data exploration interfaces using React or Angular, and design enterprise-grade cloud data streaming and analytical pipelines on GCP. You will lead distributed engineering squads across local and global locations, driving cloud modernization, data governance, and operational reliability to fuel Ford’s digital transformation.

### **1. Technical Leadership, Architecture & Modernization**

* **Anchor Technical Delivery:** Act as the primary technical anchor, translating complex business requirements from legacy applications in GDIA into scalable, fault-tolerant system designs, architectural blueprints, and execution roadmaps.
* **Architecture Standards:** Drive the evolution of Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA), cloud-native microservices, and event-driven patterns. Establish coding standards, API contracts (OpenAPI/Swagger), and architectural governance across squads.
* **Legacy System Modernization:** Lead legacy modernization initiatives by re-architecting monolithic services into modular, containerized workloads on GCP, engineering continuous ingestion flows from heterogeneous enterprise platforms.
* **Engineering Mentorship & SDLC Excellence:** Champion agile engineering best practices, enforce test-driven development (TDD), lead comprehensive code reviews, and mentor engineers across full-stack, data engineering, and cloud domains.

### **2. Full-Stack & Microservices Engineering**

* **Backend Services:** Architect and develop robust, high-performance microservices and RESTful APIs using Java 17+, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, and supporting synchronous transactions and asynchronous event-driven flows.
* **Frontend & Data Visualization:** Build responsive, user-centric interfaces using Angular, React, and Node.js that integrate seamlessly with backend APIs to deliver intuitive self-service data access, reporting, and interactive data visualization.
* **API Gateway & Service Mesh:** Design and standardize API gateway topologies using Apigee; enforce service discovery, circuit breakers, rate limiting, and resilient inter-service communication.
* **Performance Engineering & Optimization:** Profile and optimize distributed systems end-to-end, including JVM tuning, connection pooling, caching strategies, and database query tuning across relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL datastores.

### **3. Cloud Data Engineering & Analytics**

* **Scalable Data Pipelines:** Architect, build, and maintain real-time streaming and high-volume batch data pipelines leveraging GCP Dataflow (Apache Beam), Dataproc (Spark/Hadoop), and Cloud Pub/Sub.
* **Modern Data Warehousing:** Standardize, model, partition, and optimize enterprise datasets within Google BigQuery to ensure exceptional SQL query performance, cost efficiency, and real-time analytical capabilities.

### **4. Security, Governance & Compliance**

* **Zero Trust Security:** Enforce least-privileged access control across applications, integrating Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), ADFS, OAuth2/OIDC, and method-level access authorization.
* **Cloud & Data Governance:** Implement robust cloud security frameworks, including Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), data encryption (in transit and at rest), data masking, and GCP-native row-level and column-level security.
* **Regulatory Compliance:** Partner with cybersecurity, compliance, and governance teams to maintain adherence to enterprise data privacy mandates and corporate security standards.

### **5. DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure & Observability**

* **Infrastructure as Code (IaC):** Automate and manage repeatable cloud infrastructure and platform provisioning using Terraform.
* **CI/CD Automation:** Design and optimize enterprise CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Tekton, and build automation tools (Maven, Gradle) for automated testing, static code analysis, and zero-downtime deployments.
* **Operational Reliability & Telemetry:** Establish proactive monitoring, tracing, and alerting frameworks across Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), Cloud Run, and Cloud Functions to diagnose distributed system bottlenecks and ensure platform health.
* **AI/ML Innovation:** Apply foundational AI and Machine Learning (ML) concepts, including Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs), to accelerate engineering workflows and enhance software capabilities.

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent practical experience).
* **Professional Experience:** 10+ years of progressive software engineering experience delivering enterprise-scale solutions across full-stack development, distributed computing, and data platforms.
    
  **Core Technical Competencies:**
* **Backend Engineering:** Deep expertise in **Java (Java 17+)**, **Spring Ecosystem** (Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Data, Spring Security), and scripting proficiency.
* **Frontend Engineering:** Hands-on experience developing data visualization and exploration interfaces using **React**, **Angular**, or **Node.js**.
* **GCP Cloud Platforms:** Proven track record architecting and deploying systems on **Google Cloud Platform (GCP)**, specifically **BigQuery**, **Cloud Run**, **GKE** and **Cloud Pub/Sub**.
* **Database Systems:** Strong practical expertise with relational databases (**PostgreSQL**, **MySQL**), NoSQL datastores, and columnar analytical warehouses.
* **DevOps & IaC:** Hands-on mastery of Infrastructure as Code using **Terraform**, containerization (**Docker**, **Kubernetes**), and automated CI/CD tools (**GitHub Actions**, **Tekton**, **Maven/Gradle**).
* **API & Testing Standards:** Deep knowledge of RESTful API design (**OpenAPI/Swagger**) paired with a test-driven mindset using **JUnit** and **Mockito**

description:
The Team:

Cundall is an award-winning global, multi-disciplinary consultancy with a strong and growing presence across the Asia-Pacific region. Our leadership in sustainable business was recognized when Cundall received the World Green Building Council’s 2020 Business Leadership in Sustainability Award for the APAC region, reflecting our commitment to embedding sustainability into the way we work and the outcomes we deliver for the built environment.

Sustainability underpins everything we do. We empower our people to drive positive change, decarbonize the built environment and create energy-efficient, resilient and climate-responsive buildings and communities.

Our Building Services team delivers integrated, resilient and technology-led solutions for complex buildings and infrastructure. Our Building Automation, ELV and ICT specialists work across commercial, mission-critical, healthcare, hospitality and mixed-use developments, combining controls and systems-integration expertise with a practical understanding of construction, commissioning and building operations.

The Role:

This is an excellent opportunity for a Building Automation and ELV/ICT Engineer or Senior Engineer to join our Chennai office and contribute to projects across India, the Middle East and the wider Asia-Pacific region.

We are seeking an engineer with strong consultancy design experience in Building Management Systems (BMS), building automation and controls, supported by capability in Extra-Low Voltage (ELV), Information and Communications Technology (ICT) and electronic security systems.

The successful candidate will lead or develop coordinated controls and ELV designs from concept through construction and commissioning for commercial buildings, data centres and other complex facilities.

The role requires confident engagement with clients, architects, MEP engineers, contractors, controls specialists, system integrators and vendors, together with sound engineering judgement and strong technical documentation, coordination and communication skills.

Key Responsibilities:

* Develop Building Management System and building automation designs, including controls philosophies, points schedules, sequences of operation, system architectures, network topologies, plant schematics, control-panel requirements, integration matrices and performance specifications.
* Design and coordinate controls for HVAC, central utility plants, electrical monitoring, energy metering, lighting and other building systems, with particular emphasis on mission-critical facilities and data centres.
* Define interfaces and data exchange between BMS, SCADA, EPMS, fire alarm, security, lighting control, lifts, packaged plant and other third-party systems using appropriate open protocols.
* Design ELV and ICT systems, including fire detection and alarm, voice evacuation/public address, CCTV, access control, intrusion detection, structured cabling, LAN/Wi-Fi infrastructure, intercom, and other specialist systems as applicable.
* Prepare design criteria, layouts, schematics, calculations, technical specifications, equipment schedules, bills of quantities, cost inputs and tender documentation.
* Coordinate automation and ELV requirements with architectural, electrical, mechanical, fire-and-life-safety, security, IT and structural disciplines, including sensors, control devices, panels, power supplies, containment, network infrastructure and equipment-space requirements.
* Review vendor submissions, shop drawings, control schematics, software and graphics proposals, material submittals, method statements and technical deviations for compliance with the design intent and project requirements.
* Support tender evaluations, value engineering, technical clarifications and assessments of controls contractors, OEMs and system integrators.
* Contribute to BIM-led coordination and work effectively with Revit and CAD technicians to deliver accurate, coordinated drawings and models.
* Manage assigned deliverables, budgets and programmes across multiple projects while maintaining Cundall’s quality and safety expectations.

  
The Skills:

Qualifications and Experience:

* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Electrical, Electronics, Electronics and Communication, Instrumentation, Controls, Mechatronics, Telecommunications or a related engineering discipline.
* Typically 4–8 years of relevant consultancy or design experience for Engineer/Senior Engineer level, with demonstrable building automation or BMS experience; candidates with stronger leadership experience may be considered for a more senior position.
* Proven experience developing BMS controls philosophies, points schedules, sequences of operation, system architectures, integration requirements and commissioning documentation is essential.
* Experience producing coordinated Building Automation and ELV/ICT designs for commercial, data centre, healthcare, hospitality, industrial or large infrastructure projects.
* Proficiency in AutoCAD is essential; working knowledge of Revit, Navisworks and BIM coordination workflows is strongly preferred.
* Ability to develop technical specifications, BOQs, design reports, calculations, schematics and tender packages with limited supervision.
* Experience coordinating with clients, architects, MEP consultants, contractors, OEMs, controls specialists and system integrators.
* Familiarity with applicable Indian codes and approvals, including NBC requirements, relevant BIS/IS standards and local fire-authority expectations, together with commonly used international standards.
* Relevant certifications or training in BMS platforms, Niagara Framework, networking, RCDD, CCNA/CCNP or security systems are advantageous but not mandatory.

Technical Knowledge and Personal Attributes:

* Strong technical knowledge of BMS, HVAC controls, direct digital control, instrumentation, control panels, field devices, plant optimisation and energy-management strategies.
* Ability to write clear and technically robust sequences of operation for air-side, water-side, electrical and mission-critical systems, including normal, failure, standby and recovery modes.
* Knowledge of BACnet, Modbus, KNX, LonWorks, MQTT, OPC and common API or gateway-based integration approaches, including network architecture, interoperability and cybersecurity considerations.
* Understanding of BMS, SCADA and EPMS boundaries, high-level interfaces, alarm management, trending, graphics, reporting, analytics and data-centre monitoring requirements.
* Strong knowledge of IP-based CCTV, video management systems, access control, intrusion detection, fire detection and alarm, VESDA, public address/voice evacuation and structured cabling systems.
* Understanding of copper and fibre cabling, equipment-room planning, racks, pathways, containment, power supplies and resilience requirements.
* Working knowledge of TCP/IP networking, VLANs, PoE, switches, servers, storage, virtualisation and cybersecurity principles relevant to connected building systems.
* Awareness of relevant BIS/IS, NBC, ECBC, ASHRAE, CIBSE, ISO/IEC, TIA/EIA, NFPA and BS/EN requirements commonly referenced on Indian and international projects.
* Clear written and verbal communication in English; additional Indian language capability is welcome.
* Strong analytical, organisational and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and a collaborative approach.
* Ability to manage competing priorities, work independently when required and travel to project sites within India or internationally.
